description: Search-quality regression gate: 64 queries over the 64-page fixture corpus in data/eval/corpus.

judgment_provenance.note: The corpus was written together with the labels: grade 3 is the page written to answer the query, 2 a page that answers it substantially, 1 a related page, and unlisted pages are 0. These are not independent human judgments and say nothing about absolute search quality; the gate only detects regressions against the committed baseline.
